necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome, corresponding to diagnosis code I49.5. Given the history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, continuous ambulatory monitoring via CPT 93229 is clinically indicated to detect arrhythmic events and guide anticoagulation management.
